title: frameledger report --json
description: The result of `frameledger report FILE --json`: where one run's frame time went. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

category.description: The row's category. An open set: today frame, cpu, gpu or mem.

name.description: The row's name, as the engine wrote it.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

depth.description: The row's nesting depth; 0 is the top level.

median_ms.description: The median over the frames it appears in, in ms.

p99_ms.description: The 99th percentile over the frames it appears in, in ms.

share.description: Its total time over its span's total time, from 0 to 1, to four places; null when the span's total is 0.

passes.description: The cpu and gpu rows of every depth, per segment kind, with cpu_remainder and gpu_remainder as depth-0 entries; most total time first within a kind and category.

name.description: The frame row's name, such as wall.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

frames.description: The frames that have the row.

items.description: One frame measure in one segment kind.

frame_times.description: Each frame row name, per segment kind.

segment_kind.description: The segment's kind, the part of a segment name before its colon; an engine chooses its kinds, such as view or spot. Null for frames with no segment.

pairs.description: The pairs of neighbouring frames counted.

pacing.description: The frame-to-frame change in frame/wall, per segment kind; a kind with no pair of neighbouring frames has no entry.

cpu.description: The share of frames that are CPU-bound, from 0 to 1; null when it does not apply.

gpu.description: The share of frames that are GPU-bound, from 0 to 1; null when it does not apply.

applies.description: False when the header's pipelined is false.

bound_by.description: Which side bounds the frame, over frames with both spans.

top_pass.description: category/name of the frame's largest depth-0 cpu or gpu cost; null when the frame has none.

worst_frames.description: The 10 frames with the longest frame/wall, longest first.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value: it is the engine's own.

static.description: The static line exactly as the engine wrote it, or null when the run has none. Any JSON object.

generated_frames.description: How many of the run's frames a frame generator made.

result.description: The report. With the verdict error, a file could not be read and result holds no key.

report_verdict.description: The verdict of report: none, since a report judges nothing, or error when the file could not be read or breaks the format. A closed set.

report_exit_code.description: The exit codes a report result can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.
